verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing says founders can apply online in about 10 minutes and get business credit cards from day one, which points to fast onboarding. But the evidence never states an end-to-end timeline for full onboarding: account approval, funding, and moving payments, payroll or integrations over are not covered. missing for 10: documented approval/account-opening turnaround time, migration or switching tooling and timeline, independent or hands-on corroboration of a roughly one-week full onboarding.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months

citations.quote: Apply online in 10 minutes to experience banking unlike anything that’s come before.
Access business credit cards as soon as day one — no minimums, credit checks, or personal guarantees.
